recipes.name: Shallot Dressing
instructions: Combine the shallot and vinegar in a small bowl. Let sit for at least 3 minutes to help soften the shallot and infuse the vinegar.
Add the remaining ingredients and whisk to emulsify.
The dressing is ready to use over your favourite salad. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage This dressing can be stored in an airtight container or jar in the fridge for up to 2 days.
